title: Design System: Ming Chiang Land Economics & Land Management

hero.purpose: The single page headline; two lines on desktop.

display.purpose: Section headings; short sentences with a full stop, no eyebrow.

headline.purpose: Practice-card titles inside the sticky stack.

title.purpose: Office names and other row titles in ruled indexes.

lede.purpose: The paragraph directly under a heading, Ink 2, max 58ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, list titles, nav links. Never uppercase or tracked.

licence-zh.purpose: The four statutory professional titles only; 17-glyph subset.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Media figures, the portrait plinth, the map and the primary block on hover.

shadows.name: press
shadows.purpose: Any block while pressed, paired with translateY(1px) scale(0.97).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: UI state changes: press, lift, menu, header.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Colour, underline and footprint-glyph fill transitions.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: GSAP masked word reveals, fade-ups and clip reveals, once per element.

motion.name: item-stagger
motion.purpose: Ruled rows and list items entering together.

motion.name: scrub
motion.value: true (locked to scroll; Lenis is the only smoothing stage)
motion.purpose: Hero model-to-plan handoff and band parallax.

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: The single smooth-scroll engine; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: intro
motion.purpose: Logo assembly preloader: facets 35ms stagger, monogram stroke draw 0.8s, values 70ms stagger, wipe 0.85s power4.inOut.

motion.name: model-entrance
motion.purpose: Base and slab grid, buildings by ring, details, then the property tier by tier; camera dolly and push toward the property.

motion.name: model-idle
motion.purpose: Barely visible camera breath after the entrance, half frame rate, only in view.

motion.name: model-tilt
motion.purpose: Pointer parallax on the camera orbit; the model never rotates.

components.name: Primary Block
components.description: The one action block: Seal Red, square, casts a real shadow and presses down.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 26px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #fff; background: #C63D2A; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(23,25,28,0.40), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(23,25,28,0.14); transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A83222; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgba(23,25,28,0.30), 0 3px 8px -2px rgba(23,25,28,0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C63D2A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px -6px rgba(23,25,28,0.35); }

components.name: Outline Block
components.description: Secondary action: outlined at rest, solid ink on hover, the page's outline-versus-solid state grammar.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 26px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #17191C; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(23,25,28,0.32); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #17191C; color: #F3F4F1; border-color: #17191C; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C63D2A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); }

components.name: Index Row
components.description: The ruled row module used for offices, credentials and contact details; each office carries its own footprint glyph from the model vocabulary, outlined at rest and filled red on a fine-pointer hover. Rows are not links and do not lift.
components.html:
1. Ming Chiang Real Estate Appraisers Office

    Real estate, mortgage and public land appraisal.

    Licence
components.css: .ds-index { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(23,25,28,0.32); font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: #17191C; } .ds-index-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr auto; gap: 20px; align-items: start; padding: 28px 12px 28px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(23,25,28,0.14); } .ds-index-mark { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: 5px; overflow: visible; } .ds-index-mark rect { fill: transparent; stroke: #17191C; stroke-width: 1.25; transition: fill 160ms ease, stroke 160ms ease; } .ds-index-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-index-desc { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #4B4E53; } .ds-index-licence { font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #5C5F64; padding-top: 4px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-index-row:hover .ds-index-mark rect { fill: #C63D2A; stroke: #C63D2A; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square white field with a strong hairline, label above, two-ring focus halo, red error line.
components.html: Please enter your name.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #17191C; } .ds-input { font: inherit; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #17191C; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(23,25,28,0.32); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 14px; min-height: 48px; width: 100%; caret-color: #C63D2A; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #17191C; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #F3F4F1, 0 0 0 4px #C63D2A; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #C63D2A; } .ds-error { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: #C63D2A; min-height: 1.3em; }

components.name: Media Figure
components.description: Every photograph: fixed aspect ratio, object-fit cover, Lift shadow, square corners, clip reveal from the bottom.
components.css: .ds-figure { margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgba(23,25,28,0.30), 0 3px 8px -2px rgba(23,25,28,0.10); } .ds-figure img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

components.name: Plan Panel
components.description: The model seen from above inside the dark passage: on-dark hairline frame, translucent block fills, the subject parcel in Seal Red, a dashed site boundary and a one-line caption.
components.css: .ds-plan { position: relative; margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #202226; border: 1px solid rgba(237,238,234,0.16); font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-plan svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-plan figcaption { position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: 12px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #B6B9B3; }

narrative.overview:
The site is an architect's presentation model under studio light: a cool white ground, a chipboard-grey base, blocks whose only depth comes from real cast shadows, and one subject site picked out in the vermilion of a Taiwanese seal. Every surface, control and list on the page is a block or a plinth on that base. The page begins as the model in three dimensions and, as the visitor scrolls, lifts into plan view; later sections keep the plan's ruled row module as their structure.

The personality is precise, calm and expensive rather than decorative. Density is low: one idea per viewport, generous section spacing, short copy. Hierarchy is carried by scale contrast alone, never by labels, ornament or colour washes. The one deliberate dark passage is the same model seen at night in plan and is the only theme switch on the page.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, used only for the subject site, the primary action and active state.
Depth only from offset, soft-blurred shadows; no gradients, glass, glows or hairline-plus-shadow combinations.
Sharp corners everywhere; nothing is rounded or pill-shaped.
One Latin family, Bricolage Grotesque with optical sizing; Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese copy (the default language); Noto Serif TC only for the four statutory titles.
Motion authored once as a system: masked word reveals, clip reveals, a sticky practice stack and the hero's model-to-plan handoff.

rules.name: The Subject Site Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks exactly one thing per view: the site, the action, or the active row.

rules.name: The Theme Lock
rules.body: The page is light. The public-sector passage is the single permitted inversion.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone: no uppercase label above or beside them, no section numbers, no middle-dot strips.

rules.name: The Full-Stop Rule
rules.body: Section headings are short sentences ending in a period.

rules.name: The Studio Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows always carry an offset and a blur; never a zero-offset halo or a hard block shadow.

dos: Do use Seal Red for one thing per view: the site, the primary action, or the active mark.
Do build every list as a ruled row module with an outlined mark that fills on hover.
Do give every media figure a fixed aspect ratio, a clip reveal from the bottom and the Lift shadow.
Do keep section headings to short sentences with a full stop and let them stand alone.
Do ship finished content without JavaScript and under reduced motion.
donts: Don't add eyebrows, kickers, section numbers, uppercase tracked labels or middle-dot metadata.
Don't round any corner, add gradients or glass, or pair a hairline border with a wide shadow.
Don't put Seal Red small text on Chipboard or on the dark passage.
Don't invert another section to dark.
Don't introduce a second Latin family or italics.
